Hi all,

here's a quick summary of today's retrospective on the identity management rollout
(26 April 2026). Anika Brandauer chaired, Samuel Rinaldi took the minutes, and Lukas Novak,
Mira Ostwald and Ines Tamura joined.

We went through the patch status per server group, the exceptions the business has asked
for, and the next patch window. We agreed that hotfix releases ship every two weeks until
the backlog is below twenty items.

Actions:
- Tobias Varga: send the updated project plan to all attendees, by 3 May 2026
- Lukas Novak: clarify the licence count with procurement, by 10 May 2026
- Lukas Novak: review open incidents with the vendor, by 17 May 2026
- Lukas Novak: book the test environment for the load test, by 24 May 2026

Best,
Samuel

items.notes:
Subject: Contract for Thistlecombe Energy

Hi Jonas,

we closed the deal with Thistlecombe Energy Ltd today (13 March 2026), so please draw up
the service agreement. Use agreement number SA-2026-0448.

What they're getting: we host their document archive in our EU data centre and back it up
every night, and we run a restore test every six months. The service starts on 2 April 2026
and the monthly fee is €12,600.00.

Two extras go in the fee table: a penetration test at €7,800.00 per test, and extra storage
at €120.00 per TB per month.

Thanks,
Mira
points: hosting of the customer's document archive in an EU data centre
a restore test every six months
items.value:
The Supplier will host the Customer's document archive in its EU data centre. Every night the archive is backed up.

Every six months the Supplier will carry out a restore test to confirm that the archived documents can be recovered from backup.

Additional penetration testing and extra storage are available on request and are charged at the rates set out in section 2.
